init_tokenizer_and_llm: initialize a tokenizer, embedding layer, and vLLM LLM instance for prompt embedding inference
get_prompt_embeds: generate prompt embeddings from a chat message using a tokenizer and model embedding layer
single_prompt_inference: run single prompt inference using pre-computed prompt embeddings with the vLLM LLM generate method
batch_prompt_inference: run batch prompt inference with multiple chat messages using pre-computed prompt embeddings
main: run the complete prompt embedding inference pipeline with single and batch inference
